channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: Autonomous Solutions acquires Scythe Robotics
item.description: Scythe and its team will continue to operate as an equipment brand within ASI Landscaping, while Scythe leadership will assume roles within ASI.

item.title: American Rental Association names new board leadership
item.description: Robert H. Pedersen has been installed as board chair and Brian Richardson has been installed as the 64th president of the board of directors.

item.title: Greenlee debuts new battery-powered remote pruner
item.description: The remote pruner is designed for both ground use and hot stick compatibility.

item.title: SoftWorks Global launches Yardyly Landscaping Business Software
item.description: The SaaS solution provides tools for job scheduling, route planning, estimates, invoicing, client communication, and business analytics within a single dashboard.

item.title: Isuzu launches new body program with Aebi Schmidt
item.description: Isuzu dealers will be able to purchase completed trucks through Isuzu with the new Advantic body.

item.title: CASE continues partnership with country artist Jon Pardi
item.description: Together, they will also continue releasing new episodic videos that show his personal, hands-on experience with construction equipment.

item.title: JLG Industries rolls out AllFleet Parts
item.description: The AllFleet Parts portfolio spans more than 60 brands and supports a wide range of equipment used in landscaping.

item.title: Vroom Power makes TOWA Industries official distributor of the Vroom 3000
item.description: Under the agreement, both companies will actively bring the Vroom 3000 to market, with TOWA leading sales through its dealer network as well as direct-to-customer channels.

item.title: Coast publishes Fleet Spend Report
item.description: The full report includes benchmarks on seasonality, regional pricing and operational factors.

item.title: Landscaper shot by Vegas man with crossbow
item.description: he victim was working at the complex when he was struck and had to be treated at University Medical Center’s trauma unit.
